## Ascend910B A3 series

### Docker Image

```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.23.0rc1-a3
#        写死具体版本↑↑↑ v0.23.0rc1 → 每次发新版要手改所有md文档
```

### Startup Command

```bash
# A3 series startup with DP=2, TP=2
docker run --rm \
    --device /dev/davinci0 \
    --device /dev/davinci1 \
    -v /mnt/share/models:/root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models \
    $IMAGE \
    vllm serve /root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/GLM-5.2-w4a8c8 \
        --data-parallel-size 2 \
        --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
        --additional-config '{"enable_dsa_cp": true}'
```
